title: Strong edge-glyph dependence between adjacent words
statement: In paragraph text, the mutual information between a word's last glyph and the next word's first glyph is at least 0.15 bits and exceeds the within-page permutation null. On the practice evaluation pages (6,076 tokens) the manuscript scores 0.230 with a singleton-type share of 0.711; at the same shape the pinned generators score: self-citation 0.110 (singletons 0.699), table cipher 0.048 (0.262), table-and-grille 0.039 (0.812), and the manuscript with words shuffled within each page 0.043. None reproduces both the edge dependence and the singleton-rich vocabulary (K-001 open question 2).
source: Rozanova and Temerev 2026 (K-001) report strong shuffle-corrected edge-glyph dependence; threshold set on the practice training pages (ZL 0.210, Takahashi 0.192), below both, not on evaluation pages.
